turns.content: I need a website for my cleaning business
Just call it "Shine Bright Cleaning" and I clean houses, that's really all I know.

Now let me generate the logo:Logo is ready. Now let me build the header and footer in parallel:Now let me build the homepage:Now let me check the RootLayout to make sure it's wired up correctly:Your Shine Bright Cleaning homepage is live in the preview! Here's what was built:

- **Hero** — Full-bleed kitchen photo with a warm overlay, oversized headline, dual CTAs, and a social proof strip with star ratings
- **Services** — Staggered two-column cards with real room photos (kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, living room) and included items
- **Why Choose Us** — Bento-style layout with a large "Insured & Trusted" card, eco-friendly and satisfaction guarantee cards, plus a stats row
- **Testimonials** — Three editorial-style customer quotes with star ratings
- **CTA** — Asymmetric layout with a big headline on the left and a photo + floating badge on the right
- **Header & Footer** — Clean navigation with your logo, and a warm footer with contact info and social links
It looks nice! But how do people actually get in touch with me? I don't see my phone number or anything like that.
Good point — let me build a proper Contact page with a quote request form, and also add your real contact info. Let me ask for a couple of quick details first:
Just put something like a fake number for now, I just want people to be able to reach me somehow.

I'll build a Contact page with a quote request form and update the placeholder contact info throughout the site right now.Now add the route and update the placeholder contact info in the footer and homepage CTA:Now update the footer and homepage CTA with the consistent phone number:Done! A full Contact page is now live at `/contact` with a quote request form, your phone number `(555) 987-6543`, email, service area, and hours. The "Get a Free Quote" buttons throughout the site all link directly to it. When you're ready, just swap in your real phone number and email and it'll be good to go.

That's much better, thank you! It looks great overall.

DONE

Glad it's all coming together! You've got a solid homepage and a working contact page now. Whenever you're ready, there are still a few pages that would round out the site nicely — a Services page, an About page, and a Testimonials section.
